story_title: Lina and Adams and the Windy Day
title: Lina and Adams and the Windy Day 🪁 | Learn Weather Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Join Lina and Adams on a windy day full of surprises! 🪁☀️🌧️
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: sunny, kite, cloudy, windy, rainy, puddle, wet and sunset. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
☀️ sunny — مشمس — ensoleillé
☁️ cloudy — غائم — nuageux
🌬️ windy — عاصف / فيه الريح — venteux
🪁 kite — طائرة ورقية — cerf-volant
🌧️ rainy — ممطر — pluvieux
💧 puddle — بركة ماء — flaque d'eau
💦 wet — مبلل — mouillé
🌇 sunset — غروب الشمس — coucher de soleil

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: play the story, pause after each new word, and ask your child to say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصص باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم كلمات جديدة بطريقة ممتعة.

lines.text: It is morning. Lina and Adams are eating breakfast in the kitchen.
Milo the cat is sitting on the floor. Meow!
Look, Adams! The sun is shining. It is a sunny day!
Sunny! Hooray! Can we play outside?
When the sun is shining, we say: it is sunny.
Can you say it with me? Sunny!
Lina and Adams run into the garden.
I have my new kite! It is red and yellow.
Let's take the kite to the park!
A kite is a toy that flies in the sky.
Say it with me: kite!
Milo wants to come too. Meow, meow!
At the park, Lina looks up at the sky.
Oh! Where is the sun? I can see many big, white clouds.
The sun is hiding behind the clouds!
When there are many clouds in the sky, we say: it is cloudy.
Let's say it together: cloudy!
Cloudy is okay. We can still play!
Whoosh! Suddenly, the wind starts to blow.
The leaves fly, and the trees dance.
It is windy! This is perfect for my kite!
Adams runs, and runs, and the kite goes up, up, up into the sky!
Look! The kite is flying so high!
When the wind blows strongly, we say: it is windy.
Can you say it? Windy!
But the wind is very, very strong.
Oh no! The kite is pulling me!
Hold on, Adams! I will help you.
Lina holds the string with Adams. They pull together, slowly, slowly.
And the kite comes down safely. Hooray!
Thank you, Lina! You are a great friend.
We are a good team!
Drip, drop. Drip, drop. What is that sound?
It is raining! Water is falling from the clouds.
I have an umbrella! Come under, Lina!
When rain is falling, we say: it is rainy.
Say it with me: rainy!
Lina and Adams walk home in the rain.
In the garden, there is a big puddle of water.
Look, a puddle! Can we jump in it?
Yes! We are wearing our boots. One, two, three, jump!
Splash! Splash! Lina and Adams laugh and laugh.
Milo the cat does not like the water. Meow!
A puddle is a little pool of rain water on the ground. Say it: puddle!
Lina and Adams come inside the house.
Oh! My shirt is wet. My hair is wet too!
We are wet, wet, wet! Let's dry with a towel.
When something has water on it, we say it is wet.
Say it with me: wet!
Now they drink a warm cup of milk. Mmm, yummy!
Later, the rain stops. Lina looks out the door.
Adams, come and see! The sky is orange and pink!
The sun is going down. It is so pretty!
In the evening, when the sun goes down, we call it a sunset.
Can you say it? Sunset!
Milo comes out too. He is happy that the rain is gone. Meow!
At night, Lina and Adams are warm and dry in their bedroom.
Today was sunny, then cloudy, then windy, then rainy!
We jumped in a puddle, we got wet, and we saw the sunset. What a fun day!
Outside the window, the rain stops, and the moon smiles at them.
Good night, moon. Good night, Milo.
Good night, everyone!
